name: application-document-signature-block
title: Document Signature Block
description: Signer status rows (name, role, signed date or pending) for a document or agreement, plus a compact avatar-based signature progress summary.
useWhen: Showing who has and hasn't signed a document or agreement, alongside their role and signing date.
Summarizing overall signature completion at a glance in a smaller card or sidebar context.
avoidWhen: You need the actual drawing/capture surface for a signature — use signature-pad for the input itself, not the status display.
There's only a single signer and no multi-party tracking is needed — a simple status badge may be sufficient.
responsiveBehavior: The list variant is a single-column stack that reflows naturally at any width; the compact variant's overlapping avatar stack stays fixed-size and wraps its summary text above it.
accessibility: Each signer's status (Signed / Pending) pairs an icon with explicit text, never relying on icon or color alone.
The compact variant's placeholder avatar (initials) carries a title attribute naming the pending signer, since it has no image alt text to rely on.
Signed dates are given as explicit text (e.g. 'Signed Jun 12, 2026') rather than only a checkmark, preserving an audit-relevant detail.

variants.title: Signer list
variants.description: Three signer rows with role, signed date or pending status, and a status badge
accessibility: Each status badge pairs an icon with explicit Signed/Pending text.
